card.title: IPhone 12 Screen Stays Dim and Can't Increase Brightness Repair

source.title: IPhone 12 Screen Stays Dim and Can't Increase Brightness Repair

claims.statement: An iPhone 12 that's bright at the logo but goes very dim at the home screen needs the earpiece flex connected (it carries the light sensor); if connected, that flex may be bad—a new one loses Face ID.

procedure: Make sure the earpiece flex is connected.
Try a new earpiece flex (Face ID lost).
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
